scripture.zh: 和合本（新标点和合本，神版）

note: 所有给玩家看的文字都是 { en, zh }。at 是地图上的 [x, z] 坐标（x 向东，z 向南）；r 是触发半径；fx 是剧情效果名；kind: scripture 经文 / history 考据 / imagination 游戏想象 / reflection 思考；ref 写成 Gen 1:3；hint 是这个节点结束后出现的操作提示（可以分 touch 手机 / desk 电脑两种）；card 的 after 是“哪个节点完成以后这块陶片才出现”；after（节点上的）是这个节点结束后触发的效果。第 3 章依据 docs/设计方案.md 第 4 节，创 3:1–24 一节不缺；用的是伊甸的地图。；elders 是每位先祖头上显示的名字和岁数（岁数照创 5 的经文）。第 5 章依据 docs/设计方案.md 第 4 节“第 5 章《与神同行》”，创 5:1–32 一节不缺：十代人的家沿着一条路排开，每走到一家是一代人（位置在 src/episodes/gen-05-spots.ts）。

text.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness.
text.zh: 亚当的后代记在下面。（当神造人的日子，是照着自己的样式造的，

text.en: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
text.zh: 并且造男造女。在他们被造的日子，神赐福给他们，称他们为“人”。）

text.en: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
text.zh: 亚当活到一百三十岁，生了一个儿子，形象样式和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 亚当生塞特之后，又在世八百年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 亚当共活了九百三十岁就死了。

hint.en: Follow the road north. Each house is one generation.
hint.zh: 沿着路往北走。每一座房子是一代人。

text.en: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
text.zh: 塞特活到一百零五岁，生了以挪士。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 塞特生以挪士之后，又活了八百零七年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁就死了。

text.en: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
text.zh: 以挪士活到九十岁，生了该南。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 以挪士生该南之后，又活了八百一十五年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁就死了。

text.en: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
text.zh: 该南活到七十岁，生了玛勒列。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 该南生玛勒列之后，又活了八百四十年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 该南共活了九百一十岁就死了。

text.en: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
text.zh: 玛勒列活到六十五岁，生了雅列。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 玛勒列生雅列之后，又活了八百三十年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁就死了。

text.en: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.
text.zh: 雅列活到一百六十二岁，生了以诺。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 雅列生以诺之后，又活了八百年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁就死了。

text.en: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
text.zh: 以诺活到六十五岁，生了玛土撒拉。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 以诺生玛土撒拉之后，与神同行三百年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
text.zh: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。

text.en: Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.
text.zh: 以诺与神同行，神将他取去，他就不在世了。

text.en: You learned a gesture: Walk With. Press G (or tap “Walk With”), and a small light walks beside you.
text.zh: 你学会了一个姿态：同行。按 G 键（或点“同行”按钮），会有一团小小的光陪你走。

touch.en: You learned “Walk With”: tap the “Walk With” button.
touch.zh: 你学会了“同行”：点“同行”按钮

desk.zh: 你学会了“同行”：按 G 键

text.en: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
text.zh: 玛土撒拉活到一百八十七岁，生了拉麦。

text.en: And after he had become the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 玛土撒拉生拉麦之后，又活了七百八十二年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁就死了。

text.en: When Lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
text.zh: 拉麦活到一百八十二岁，生了一个儿子，

text.en: And he named him Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.”
text.zh: 给他起名叫挪亚，说：“这个儿子必为我们的操作和手中的劳苦安慰我们；这操作劳苦是因为耶和华咒诅地。”

text.en: And after he had become the father of Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
text.zh: 拉麦生挪亚之后，又活了五百九十五年，并且生儿养女。

text.en: So Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
text.zh: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁就死了。

text.en: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
text.zh: 挪亚五百岁生了闪、含、雅弗。

text.en: The next part of the story begins with Noah.
text.zh: 接下来的故事，要从挪亚开始。

text.en: In Genesis 5 the words “and then he died” come again and again: eight times. Only one name in the list ends differently: Enoch (Genesis 5:24). Death came, just as God had said it would (Genesis 2:17). But the list keeps going, and so does the story.
text.zh: 创世记第 5 章里，“就死了”一次又一次地出现，一共 8 次。名单里只有一个人的结尾不一样：以诺（创 5:24）。死亡临到了人，正像神先前说过的（创 2:17）。可是家谱还在往下写，故事也还在往下走。

text.en: Enoch walked with God for 300 years (Genesis 5:22). Walking with someone means going the same way, at the same pace, day after day. What would it look like for you to walk with God this week?
text.zh: 以诺与神同行三百年（创 5:22）。和一个人同行，就是天天走同一条路、跟着同样的步子。这个星期，你和神同行会是什么样子？

text.en: Methuselah lived 969 years (Genesis 5:27), the longest life recorded in the Bible. Add up the years in this chapter and you will find that Adam was still alive when Lamech, Noah’s father, was 56.
text.zh: 玛土撒拉活了 969 岁（创 5:27），是圣经里记载活得最长的人。把这一章的数字加起来算一算：挪亚的父亲拉麦 56 岁的时候，亚当还活着。

text.en: Lamech named his son Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us” (Genesis 5:29). In Hebrew the name Noah (נֹחַ) sounds like “rest” and “comfort.” People were tired from working the cursed ground (Genesis 3:17), and they were hoping for comfort.
text.zh: 拉麦给儿子起名叫挪亚，说：“这个儿子必为我们的操作和手中的劳苦安慰我们”（创 5:29）。挪亚（נֹחַ）这个名字，在希伯来文里听起来像“安息”和“安慰”。人在受了咒诅的地上劳苦（创 3:17），盼望得到安慰。

desc.en: “Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away” (Genesis 5:24). Hebrews 11:5 says he “was commended as one who pleased God.” The footprints of light he left on the hill are imagined for the game.
desc.zh: “以诺与神同行，神将他取去，他就不在世了。”（创 5:24）希伯来书 11:5 说，他“已经得了神喜悦他的明证”。他在山上留下的光的脚印，是游戏的想象。

desc.en: A small light walks beside you as you go. Learned from: Enoch, who walked with God (Genesis 5:22–24).
desc.zh: 走路的时候，有一团小小的光陪在你身边。学自：与神同行的以诺（创 5:22–24）。
